 Yuvraj Samrat Scores First Half-Century in Nepal Premier League
 Ratopati
 November 09, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Yuvraj Samrat of Pokhara Avengers has scored the first half-century in the Nepal Premier League (NPL) cricket.
 In the match against Karnali Yaks at the TU Cricket Ground in Kirtipur on Monday, Yuvraj crossed the mark of 50 runs with 2 sixes and 7 fours in 23 balls.
